title: tracker show --json
description: Everything about one item (DESIGN.md §3): its fields, verification records and history, and with --diff its commits and their diff.

item.description: The item as this version of tracker reads it. A file written by a newer tracker can hold more, which warning names.

commits.description: Only with --diff: the item's commits (DESIGN.md §2.1), the commits reachable from HEAD whose header is scoped to its ID, newest first. Empty when it has none.

diff.description: Only with --diff: each of the item's commits with its patch, oldest first, as git show prints them, including files outside the project's root. Empty when it has no commits.

warning.description: Present only when the item's file holds top-level fields this version doesn't know or can't show in full, such as ones a newer tracker added. It names them, and item leaves them out or shows them changed.
